integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, nostalgic American/European film style with high-contrast warm saturated tones, a slow forward tracking follow shot glides down an old American town street lined with brown brick buildings, classic vintage convertibles parked along the roadside, nostalgic street signs, and weathered walls. Warm afternoon side backlight falls diagonally across the scene, creating a strong vintage street atmosphere. The female lead — consistent throughout in a worn light-blue denim cropped jacket, body-hugging high-waisted denim mini skirt, wide vintage belt, silver metallic accessories, refined retro makeup and hair — dances with large, rhythmic movements: hip twists, hip pushes, and waist sways, her stage presence relaxed yet expressive, cut crisply to the beat. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a red-orange-blue color-block crosswalk area where sunlight divides the ground into layered geometric shadows, with a smooth natural transition matching the beat. The camera performs a lateral panning shot as the girl, styling and facial features unchanged, steps precisely on the beat, moving left and right in syncopated dance motions while both arms swing naturally along with her steps; patches of light and shadow underfoot intertwine and change with her movement. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to the side of a red British-style vintage telephone booth, captured with a fast orbiting shot around her. The girl holds the edge of the booth frame with one hand, her body slightly turned and leaning against the booth wall, gently lifting her chin, the other hand half tucked into the side pocket of her skirt. She tilts her head and looks back, her gaze directed straight into the camera as the orbit settles into a confident, lingering final pose on the beat.

overall_soundscape: Soft outdoor afternoon ambience with a faint breeze and distant street atmosphere. Crisp footfalls, the rustle of denim, and the subtle jingle of silver metallic accessories land in sync with the beat, growing punchy through the dance and settling as she holds the final pose.

non_diegetic_music: The retro disco pop track "Cruel Summer" plays at a steady upbeat tempo throughout — bright syncopated synth-pop groove with a driving beat, its rhythm crisply matching every dance step, camera move, and cut, sustaining energy until the final pose.
